---
applyTo: "**/*"
---

# Translation Instructions

- When adding or updating user-facing text, add or update the German (`de`) resource or locale translation only.
- Do not add English or any other non-German locale translations. The team has a separate established translation process for all non-German languages.
- Leave all other locale files untouched when implementing user-facing text.
- If existing non-German translation entries are encountered, do not remove or modify unrelated entries.
- Missing non-German translations are expected and must be handled later by the established translation process.
